assumptions: Crowd mix for a concert: 65% regulars who know the venue, 30% first-time visitors, 5% staff and volunteers.
Familiarity: 80% of regulars, 10% of first-time visitors and all staff know the other exits.
Most of the crowd stands in front of the stage, thinning towards the back.
Attendees came in through the main gates (EX-G1, EX-G3); staff through EX-G4.
Mobility: 2% walk slowly, 0.5% use crutches, 0.5% use wheelchairs.
The fire starts in Fete Area (ground level) centre third (Z1C).
Venue: Outline is the OSM "Fete Area" polygon (way 396666360, 281848 sq ft); the event perimeter is assumed to follow it.
Venue: Stage position is not in OSM: a 90 ft x 40 ft stage is assumed at the middle of the north edge, facing south.
Venue: Gates are placed where OSM paths and service roads meet the boundary (4 gates); their widths (20 ft main, 12 ft others) are assumptions.
Venue: Main gates (where attendees entered): G1, G3; the gate nearest the stage (G4) is assumed to be the backstage/staff gate.
Venue: Ground is treated as flat and open, with no fixed seating, barriers or stalls inside the perimeter.
note: Scenario agent offline (no key or EXITMIND_OFFLINE=1); used the offline keyword parser.
venueLabel: Saturnalia concert ground (Fete Area), TIET Patiala
